name: Koreanavy  Kss3 Class   Submarine
designation: KSS-III Dosan Ahn Changho-class diesel-electric attack submarine
axis_orientation: bow (nose) is at +1, stern (propulsor/planes) is at -1
operating_principle: The KSS-III submarine operates using diesel-electric propulsion, with an advanced air-independent propulsion system allowing extended submerged endurance without snorkeling. The submarine is equipped with a range of weapons, including submarine-launched ballistic missiles and torpedoes.

components.description: The main structural body of the submarine, providing a strong and watertight compartment for the crew and equipment.
The sail or fin of the submarine, housing the command and control systems, as well as communication and navigation equipment.
The compartment where the submarine's torpedoes are stored and launched from.
The compartments housing the air-independent propulsion system, batteries, and other machinery.
The compartment where the submarine's command and control systems are located.
The electric motor that powers the submarine's propeller.
The propeller or propulsor that provides the submarine's propulsion.
components.material_dependency: High strength steel or composite materials

components.description: The control surfaces that provide stability and control during diving and surfacing.
